expected_clause_types.note: Defines base wage/salary, payment frequency, and exempt/non-exempt status.
Sets official start date and prerequisites (e.g. background check, I-9 verification).
Affirms employment status and terms under applicable labor standards.
Specifies formal position title, department, and reporting manager.
Summarizes health insurance, retirement plan, and paid time off (PTO) eligibility.
Protects company confidential information and trade secrets.
Defines separation procedures, notice expectations, or severance provisions.
Clarifies primary work location, remote/hybrid arrangements, and core hours.
Specifies annual bonus structure, commission plans, or equity eligibility if offered.

notes: Starter list based on standard employment offer letter practices. Engineering default checklist, not legal advice.
